The Drafter has it where it counts.|[[Legendary Motorsport]] description.}} The [[Obey]] '''8F Drafter''' is a two-door coupe appearing in {{O}}, and due to appear in {{VI}}. ==Description== ===''Grand Theft Auto Online''=== The 8F Drafter was added as part of [[GTA Online: The Diamond Casino & Resort|The Diamond Casino & Resort]] update, made available to purchase immediately from the day of the update's release. ===''Grand Theft Auto VI''=== The rear of a black 8F Drafter can be distantly seen driving down a main thoroughfare in an [[Grand Theft Auto VI/Screenshots#Ambrosia|official screenshot]] of [[Ambrosia]]. ==Influence== The design of the 8F Drafter appears to draw significant inspiration from the {{WP|Audi A5#RS5|2018 Audi RS5 Coupe}}. The primary grille and front bumper take cues from the {{WP|Ford Mustang (sixth generation)#Shelby GT350 (2015–2020)|2015–2020 Ford Mustang Shelby GT350}}, while the headlights bear a resemblance to those of the {{WP|Ford Falcon (FG X)}}. The side profile is reminiscent of the {{WP|BMW M4#First generation (F82/F83; 2014)|BMW M4 CS (F82)}}, featuring a characteristic line that extends from the rear taillight housing to a side vent. Additionally, the rear exhaust and bumpers closely mirror those of the M4 CS. The taillights are largely influenced by the second-gen RS5 coupe; however, the RS5 coupe does not feature connected taillights, instead drawing some inspiration from the {{WP|file=Audi_TT_Sportback_Concept_-_Mondial_de_l%27Automobile_de_Paris_2014_-_002.jpg|2014 Audi TT Sportback Concept}}. The wheels seem to be modeled after the {{URL|https://www.weldwheels.com/weld-street-and-strip/performance-rf-wheels/belmont-s113.html|WELD Belmont S113}}. The [[Vehicle Features/Engines|engine]] is based on a generic model that resembles the {{WP|Mercedes-Benz M113 engine#E55K AMG|Mercedes-Benz M113 Kompressor engine}}, while the [[Vehicle Features/Interior Dashboards|interior]], referred to internally as "super2" and first introduced with the [[Specter]], appears to be inspired by the {{WP|Chevrolet Corvette (C7)}}. ===Liveries=== *The "Racing The Edge" livery is a reference to the iconic {{WC|nfs|File:NFSW BMW M3 GTR E46 Most Wanted.jpg|BMW M3 GTR (E46)}} from ''{{WP|Need for Speed: Most Wanted (2005 video game)|Need for Speed: Most Wanted}}'' and ''{{WP|Need for Speed: Carbon}}''. ==Design== The 8F Drafter boasts a sleek, sporty 2-door coupe design enhanced with various aftermarket parts in its original state, including a front splitter and rear diffuser. Drawing inspiration from models like the [[9F]] and [[Tailgater]], it incorporates modern elements, such as fully LED headlights. The back of the car also resembles the Tailgater but with a sporty twist: twin double-exit exhausts are positioned beneath a prominent splitter, and a subtle, upward-swept ducktail-like feature graces the rear boot lid. The car uses a dedicated "Super2" interior, which is largely identical to the one seen in the [[Dominator GTX]] (itself being the same interior from the [[Specter]]), except for the vented section on the front of the dashboard, under the windscreen. The Obey logo can be seen on the horn cap. The primary colour of the 8F Drafter is applied on the body, while the secondary colour is applied on the lower splitter and interior stitching. It uses a unique set of split five-spoke rims with small bifurcations on the ends and small additional spokes on each main spoke. The rims also have a black finish with an additional colouring around it (although only models generated in the [[Content Creator]] or obtained from the [[Lucky Wheel]] will have the default white colour). ==Performance== The 8F Drafter is a very high-performing car in the sports category. It lacks top speed but makes up for its loss by having a superior acceleration. Braking is also one of the best in the sport category. Handling on the car is even in parallel with some supercars. It is highly recommended to obtain this vehicle if the player decides to race in the sports category as it has superior performance compared to other vehicles in this class. The 8F Drafter is powered by what appears to be a V8 engine (based on the cover), coupled to a 6-speed gearbox in a front engine, all wheel drive layout (40–60, front to rear distribution).
